class ledger.era.dijkstra.DijkstraTx.note: the GADT's two constructors are two final classes of one sealed class, each made only by the decoder

def ledger.era.dijkstra.DijkstraTx#sizeT.note: the bytes of the parts as they arrived, which re-encoding a memoized part writes, and one for the list of three

def ledger.era.dijkstra.DijkstraTx.forBl.note: of a top-level transaction only, as the reference's (Tx TopTx era); the parts' memoized bytes and the flag of its verdict last

def ledger.era.dijkstra.DijkstraTx.fromS.note: read from the item straight into the era's types in one pass (DijkstraTxBody.readTop, DijkstraTxWits.read, DijkstraTxAuxData.read), with the Leios build's block decoder's refusals in its order; its sub-transactions at the sub-transaction level in the order read and by id; the decoder refuses an id twice (`decodeNonEmptySetLikeEnforceNoDuplicatesAnn (flip OMap.|>)`, `TxBody.hs:467-471`), and the ordered map refuses it again; its verdicts on every recorded transaction, on fixed mutants of them, and on written cases (competing refusals across the parts and within one, the first reported; every form of Plutus data in datums and redeemers; a fault at each key of a body, a sub-transaction's body, a witness set and auxiliary data) are those of the two passes it replaced (the flat block decoder and its projection), recorded before they were deleted (DijkstraOnePassExpected); every refusal is the decoder's (EraTxError.Decode); the one read the mempool takes (DijkstraRead.submitted)

def ledger.era.dijkstra.DijkstraTx.inBlo.note: read from the item straight into the era's types in one pass (DijkstraTxBody.readTop, DijkstraTxWits.read, DijkstraTxAuxData.read), with the Leios build's block decoder's refusals in its order; its sub-transactions at the sub-transaction level in the order read and by id; the decoder refuses an id twice (`decodeNonEmptySetLikeEnforceNoDuplicatesAnn (flip OMap.|>)`, `TxBody.hs:467-471`), and the ordered map refuses it again; its verdicts on every recorded transaction, on fixed mutants of them, and on written cases (competing refusals across the parts and within one, the first reported; every form of Plutus data in datums and redeemers; a fault at each key of a body, a sub-transaction's body, a witness set and auxiliary data) are those of the two passes it replaced (the flat block decoder and its projection), recorded before they were deleted (DijkstraOnePassExpected); every refusal is the decoder's (EraTxError.Decode); caveat: the node is trusted to be the CBOR parser's, its value the reading of its bytes, as every decoder of a node assumes, since a node built by hand can hold a value its bytes are not (https://github.com/KD5UJC-XYZ/scarab/issues/85#issuecomment-6999001864)

def ledger.era.dijkstra.DijkstraTx.submi.note: the mempool form read from an item the caller already read as CBOR within its own bounds (the node-to-node transaction submission's, RelayedTransactions), as fromSubmission reads it: three items, or four with a boolean third that must be true, each part in one pass

def ledger.era.dijkstra.DijkstraTx.trans.note: each part's memoised bytes read whole at Dijkstra's version (translateEraThroughCBOR), in the reference's order, the flag kept; the body is read by the top-level body's reader in one pass (DijkstraTxBody.readTop), as DijkstraTx's decoders read one. Unwired: Scarab's 11.1 build, whose injection uses it (hardForkInjectTxs, ouroboros-consensus 82ecba329), never enters Dijkstra

def ledger.era.dijkstra.DijkstraTx.withI.note: the lens's setter on a top-level transaction; the era's transaction keeps no bytes of the whole, so its parts' memoised bytes, its size and its id are unchanged

val ledger.era.dijkstra.DijkstraTx.insta.note: every member the class has here: `mkBasicTx` is no member of it for any era, `validateNativeScript` is `validateDijkstraNativeScript` (Tx.hs:427-438), and `allInputsTxBodyF` is `EraTxBody.allInputs`; `getTotalExUnits` adds each sub-transaction's units to the top level's, its redeemers' units and each sub-transaction's on every Dijkstra transaction the repository holds (DijkstraUTxOSuite), as the flat measure gave until the flat decoder went (#85). `DijkstraEraTx`'s `hashTx` (`Tx.hs:445-472`) is not here (https://github.com/KD5UJC-XYZ/scarab/issues/85#issuecomment-7024127184); the annotated transaction's members read from their deferred values (`Eval`)

glue.reason: Dijkstra's transactions on the era types (#85): the companions holding their decoders, instances and CanEqual, Scala's equality, hash and rendering of each, which the reference derives, the fields both levels of a body share, held once, with the narrowing of a top-level body to its constructor, which the reference's GADT match does, and an account balance interval from the body reader's; the Plutus scripts made in Dijkstra's types from the language and bytes read; and the bounds' companions; the proof that a value was read from bytes by the decoders (`DijkstraTx.FromBytes`), which only `DijkstraTx` makes and keeps, and the witness set's and auxiliary data's readers from bytes through it
